acceptance: Reported three common-engine fixes verified in representative Win10 and Win11 VM cases, with stated limits

verified.representative: Astra both product lines, with Gemini original/Plus and cross-repository spot checks

limits: Win11 startup can be delayed: the 200% non-avoidance process naturally appeared about 46.26 seconds after Explorer, beyond the initial 35-second observer. Original observation is retained.

Custom-theme Person Stop restoration can return the registry path while shared pixels differ. This pre-existing code path was not changed; causality versus the old build was not established. Failed subchecks remain visible.

The old Win11 non-avoidance baseline was quarantined by Defender after its six 96-size samples, leaving old Win11 avoidance/256/reboot comparisons uncollected. Current candidate interval showed no new detection events; protection stayed enabled.
Tests used 4-vCPU, 8-GiB VMs with 1024x768 capture and approximately 64Hz tracking; no physical Surface Pro7 2736x1824, mixed-monitor DPI or 200Hz acceptance.
Zero CPU-time deltas are not zero cost; cycle counters are only compared within the same VM.
Full 416-profile runtime matrix was cancelled at the user's reduced representative-test scope; all 22 packages received static member/hash/frame-reference checks.
Person ANI structure and per-step source pixels were preserved; identical source steps do not prove distinct visible animation frames or timing.
